name: MermaidSeqBench
description: MermaidSeqBench is a benchmark for evaluating large language models' ability to generate Mermaid sequence diagrams from textual prompts, assessing syntax correctness, activation handling, error handling, and practical usability.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark from the paper introducing MermaidSeqBench; it is not yet widely established but is relevant to diagram-generation evaluation.
notes: Benchmark expanded via human annotation, LLM prompting, and rule-based variation; reveals significant capability gaps across models.
